quotes.text: Thank-you so much to our guide Gillian, and our captain Glenn. They were so knowledgeable! It was a calm day and very relaxing to be out on the water. We chatted the whole time with our guide and learnt all about Halifax and Dartmouth. Saw the naval base and where they took the rescued Titanic victims. The boat is lovely and quiet. Very comfortable. There are so many blankets and scarves on board if you get chilly but I was comfortable in just my sweater. I would highly recommend spending an hour on this tour!

We had a wonderful time on this tour! Our guide Julia was very knowledgeable and great to chat with. They gave us lots of great information on the history of the area and the boats that were docked. They were very accommodating as well, our original time slot had to be cancelled due to weather and they were helpful with getting us rebooked for a time that worked with our schedule. Highly recommend!

We thoroughly enjoyed this small group tour! There were 8 of us in total-three small groups of people and we had such an enjoyable tour. Ben, our tour guide, kept us informed about the history and fun facts of the area and Glenn, the Captain also contributed great information as well. We laughed and learned for the entire hour. I would highly recommend this tour, especially with Ben and Glenn!

An excellent boat tour. I booked direct with the company on their website. Very easy to book and very easy to find as we visited by cruise. Gorgeous Boat, I love that it started life back home in London, UK! It’s now an electric boat and was so quiet! A great captain and great guide! A very relaxing sail along Halifax’s harbour front. Sit on the back seat for great views! Highly recommend!

The tour was amazing! It was a nice and calm ride going through the tour with our captain, Glenn, giving us a pleasant ride. Our guide, Nancy, gave us great insight to the local histories of the harbor and recommendations to explore while providing an uplifting mood to the overall experience. I would greatly recommend taking the tour with them!

A highlight of our trip to Halifax! The boat is beautiful and so quiet with the electric motor. We did a moonlight cruise around the harbor with Captain Christian - he was so informative and also funny! The attention to detail was amazing - blankets for a chilly night, for example. Highly recommend, this is must do experience!
